editorial:
Imagine spending your whole life being the nicest person in the room, only to get to the pearly gates and find out your name is missing from the guest list. That is exactly what happens to Sarah, a total sweetheart who dies in a freak accident right before the holidays. You will feel for her immediately as she tries to figure out why she is being kept out of paradise. The movie has a cozy, warm vibe that feels like a big hug, making it the perfect choice for a rainy afternoon or a family movie night. It takes a familiar setup and adds a fun twist by turning the afterlife into a sort of probation period.

You will love how the story moves along quickly, keeping you interested as Sarah races against the clock. The acting is believable and sweet, though some parts feel a bit like a typical TV movie. It is not a complex plot, but the emotional payoffs are real. If you are looking for something heartwarming, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for anyone who needs a little faith in humanity.
endingExplained: After spending twelve days helping a struggling soul and learning that true kindness comes from the heart, Sarah finally earns her spot in heaven. She proves she has the selflessness needed to be an angel. In the final scenes, she says a tearful goodbye to the people she helped on Earth. She returns to the gates, where she is finally welcomed in and given her wings, completing her journey just in time for Christmas.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good holiday stories and stories about the afterlife.
